audit.back_translation: CAC is a mixed average, not a marginal CAC or proof that a campaign caused every sale.Payback uses revenue × gross margin as a simple monthly estimate of gross profit; it excludes churn, payment times, taxes, overheads, and changing customer cohorts.

back_sample.translation: CAC is a mixed average, not a marginal CAC or proof that a campaign caused every sale.Payback uses revenue × gross margin as a simple monthly estimate of gross profit; it excludes churn, payment times, taxes, overheads, and changing customer cohorts.

candidate.raw_translation: Il CAC è una media mista, non un CAC marginale o la prova che una campagna ha causato ogni vendita. Payback utilizza i ricavi × il margine lordo come una semplice stima mensile del profitto lordo; esclude il churn, i tempi di pagamento, le tasse, le spese generali e le coorte di clienti che cambiano.
candidate.source: Count costs and customers from the same period and acquisition scope. CAC is a blended average, not marginal CAC or proof that a campaign caused each sale. Payback uses revenue × gross margin as a simple monthly gross-profit estimate; it excludes churn, payment timing, taxes, overhead and changing customer cohorts. Not financial advice.
